1.consolidated_definition: Cigüeñal, manubrio. Eje con codos que transforma un movimiento rectilíneo en circular. Anglicismo crudo, frecuente. Una vez que mi carro dio un cantazo heavy, creí que había roto la tapa del crank (carrito.net, foro, 2003)
1.en_consolidated_definition: Crankshaft, connecting rod. Axle with knuckles that transforms a linear movement into a circular one. Anglicism, often used in informal contexts. Once my car gave a heavy jolt, I thought I had cracked the crank (carrito.net, forum, 2003)

2.consolidated_definition: drog. Droga preparada a base de sustancias volátiles y tóxicas que se inhala o inyecta. Anglicismo crudo, poco frecuente. Se le denomina crank a la droga preparada ilegalmente en la calle (Alianza para un Puerto Rico sin drogas, consultado 19-11-07)
2.en_consolidated_definition: Chemical substance prepared from volatile and toxic substances that is inhaled or injected. A crude Anglicism, infrequently used. It is also referred to as crank when the illicitly manufactured drug is sold on the street (Alliance for a Drug-Free Puerto Rico, consulted 19-11-07)
